race.comment: Looks another lovely option for DIRTY LOOK (3) who has won both starts back from a spell, far too good first up then recording another soft victory at Cranbourne in this grade out to 1400m. Fresh for the slight drop in trip looks a nice recipe and her turn of foot will be hard to match late, especially with the main danger coming out. LEGACY BAY (14) didn't fire first up at Seymour but was in the market and can improve sharply, respecting on her best form last time in. JAMESJOHNO (13) could surprise first up having always hinted at ability while ALERO (1) was a forgive on the heavy at Flemington having won well here fresh, consider.
